mission.title: To win the lost, To make disciples, To raise a new generation of leaders
mission.description: Our mission is to engage and mobilise every member in the mission of Jesus Christ.

clips.title: College Tent Revival
clips.description: On July 11th, our College Ministry had a Tent Revival Outreach at CBU Campus - and we saw 1500 attenders, and 700 of them responded to the alter call. God is Good!

clips.title: College / Youth Conference
clips.description: On July 24th - 25th, We saw 1000 attenders at our first Annual Youth Conference. Pastor Zinhle and Thokozile from 3C Church Centurion, SA, were our special guests. It was Simply Amazing!

clips.title: High School Outreach
clips.description: Earlier this year our High School members did a Plan 40 outreach to all their Friends, Relatives, Neighbors & Classmates. We had 600 in attendance with several hundred who responded to the Alter Call. Incredible!

clips.title: Weekly Cell Groups
clips.description: The heartbeat of MercyGen is the Cell Group. Everything we do from winning the lost, Discipleship & Leadership Development all emerge out of our Cell System.

clips.title: Leadership Training
clips.description: One of our highest goals is to develop every member into an influential Leader for Jesus Christ. Becoming fruitful for Jesus is a high value at MercyGen. Training is our Happy Hour!

clips.title: Kids Invasion
clips.description: Lately we are being invaded by lots and lots of kids who live in the neighborhoods where we run our services. They're a Gift from God!

greatLove.title: Our Great Love
greatLove.description: A glimpse into the love that drives everything we do at MercyGen.

updates.description: We will distribute food, encouragement, and prayer materials across the community.

updates.title: Rise with purpose
updates.description: A high-energy gathering where young people hear the Word and move in bold faith.
